title: Boli 25 crore, player ko sirf 18 kyun?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: Videshi star mega auction skip karte the...
mini auction me jackpot: Starc ko 24.75 crore!
Isliye rule: videshi ko MAX 18 crore.
Baaki 7? BCCI ke paas, welfare me.
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
IPL auction me KKR ne Cameron Green ke liye ₹25.20 crore ki boli lagayi... par Green ko milenge sirf ₹18 crore! 🤯

Raaz: IPL ka "maximum fee" rule. Mini auction me videshi player ki fees zyada se zyada ₹18 crore (sabse badi retention slab) ho sakti hai. Team ke purse se poore ₹25.20 crore katte hain, par upar ke ₹7.2 crore BCCI ke paas jaate hain, players ki welfare ke liye.

Rule kyun aaya? Teams ka kehna tha ki kuch videshi star bada (mega) auction chhod ke chhote (mini) auction me aate the, jahan players kam aur demand zyada hoti hai. 2024 ke mini auction me Starc ko ₹24.75 crore aur Cummins ko ₹20.50 crore mile the.

IPL 2027 ki retention deadline aa gayi hai, phir mini auction... tumhari team kise khareedegi? Comment karo 👇
